Banner''' is a [[banner]] [[aura]] [[skill]]. After gaining [[Valour]] from melee combat, it can be activated, consuming all Valour and placing a banner that [[buff]]s the user and [[allies]] within an area with increased [[accuracy]] and more physical damage with [[melee]] skills. The effect of the aura is multiplied based on the amount of Valour consumed. [[File:War Banner skill screenshot.png|thumb|right|A [[Marauder]] with a War Banner attached on his back]] [[File:War Banner skill screenshot 2.png|thumb|right|A War Banner placed on the ground (Gem level 1, quality 20, initial stage)]] ==Mechanics== {{c|mod|#% more Physical Damage with Melee Skills}} grants all skills with the melee [[gem tag]] a general {{c|mod|% more Physical Damage}} modifier. This applies to physical hit damage, hit damage [[conversion|converted]] from physical into another type, and physical [[damage over time]] such as {{stl|Bleeding}}. (Though not {{il|Corrupting Fever}} applied by melee hits.) ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Aura Effect
per Valour |c1_header = x% more Aura effect per Valour consumed |c1_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Aura effect per Valour consumed |c1_pattern_value = %d%% |c2_abbr = AoE
per Valour |c2_header = x% more Area of Effect per Valour consumed |c2_pattern_extract = (%d+)%% more Area of Effect per Valour consumed |c2_pattern_value = %s%% }} {{Item acquisition}} ==Ruthless mode== War Banner cannot be obtained from [[quest]]s or traded for using an {{il|Uncarved Gemstone}} through [[Siosa]] in [[Ruthless mode]]. {{Skill enchantment modifier list}} ==Related unique items== The following [[unique item]]s are related to War Banner: {{Drop enabled unique item table |where = items.stat_text LIKE "%War%Banner%" OR items.name LIKE "%Perfidy%" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} {{Alternate skill effect list|query= items.class_id="Microtransaction" AND cosmetic_items.cosmetic_type LIKE "Skill Gem Effect" AND ( BINARY items.name LIKE "%Dread Banner%" OR BINARY items.description LIKE "%Dread Banner%" OR items.description LIKE "%your banner%" OR BINARY items.name LIKE "Invisible Buff Effect" ) }} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.25.0| * Is no longer a Reservation skill, and has none of its previous stats. You must gain Valour from melee combat to use this skill, which will consume all Valour to place a Banner with an aura. The aura will be larger and more powerful the more Valour was consumed. The banner lasts for a duration, but will end early if you leave the aura, or use the skill again while it's active. While you have no placed banner, you can gain Valour. Now has a base duration of 10 seconds, and a base radius of 2.4 metres. Provides 5% more Area of Effect and 5% more Aura Effect per Valour Consumed at gem level 1, both scaling up to 10% at gem level 20. Banner grants 8% increased Accuracy Rating to You and Allies, and 4% more Physical Damage with Melee Skills to You and Allies at all gem levels. Now has a Mana cost of 13 at gem level 1, scaling up to 19 at gem level 20. }} {{Version history table row|3.7.0| * Now grants you and nearby allies 15% increased accuracy rating at gem level 1 (from 40%), up to 21% at gem level 20 (from 59%). }} {{Version history table row|3.5.0| * War Banner has been added to the game. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
